programme.title: The Point With Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin's very own unique perspective.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Aparição
programme.desc: Um grupo de jovens, guiados por uma app que conecta os vivos com os mortos, vai parar a um castelo abandonado com uma história terrível e ligações misteriosas a cada um deles.

programme.title: Rostos Na Multidão
programme.desc: Anna testemunhou o crime de um serial killer, caiu de uma ponte e ficou em coma por uma semana. Quando acorda, é-lhe diagnosticada prosopagnosia, a incapacidade de reconhecer rostos, o que se torna muito complicado quando o assassino se aproxima para tentar matá-la.

programme.title: A Inspeção
programme.desc: Ellis Fench, um jovem negro e homossexual, rejeitado pela mãe e com poucas opções de futuro, decide alistar-se nos Fuzileiros mas vai ter de sobreviver a todo um sistema que tudo fará para o pôr de lado.

programme.title: True Justice: Guerras De Rua
programme.desc: Elijah Kane e a sua equipa entram em ação depois de ocorrerem várias mortes na área de Seattle, relacionadas com um novo tipo de ecstasy. Kane inicia este trabalho infiltrado como segurança de uma equipa que filma um documentário.

programme.title: True Justice: Droga Assassina
programme.desc: Elijah Kane comanda uma equipa de polícias à paisana em Seattle que procura grandes criminosos, derrotando-os pela justiça bruta de rua. Kane, embora admirável, possui um passado rodeado de mistério.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas…

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Judah Ben-Hur é um nobre judeu, cuja heroica odisseia inclui ser escravizado pelos romanos, fugir de um barco de escravos durante uma batalha, vingar-se contra os seus carrascos durante uma violenta corrida de quadrigas numa arena e ainda um fatídico encontro com Jesus Cristo.

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: Her Smell - A Música Nas Veias
programme.desc: Uma cantora de punk rock auto-destrutiva luta por se manter sóbria, enquanto tenta recuperar a inspiração e a criatividade que catapultou a sua banda para o sucesso.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: Gauguin
programme.desc: Em 1891, Gauguin foi para o Taiti para reencontrar a sua pintura, longe da moral, da política e da estética dos códigos da Europa civilizada. Embrenha-se na selva, enfrentando a solidão, a pobreza e a doença, e aí conhece Tehura, que viria a tornar-se a sua mulher e o tema das suas obras.

programme.title: Últimas Notícias De Yuba County
programme.desc: Uma mulher do Kentucky a que ninguém dá atenção, Sue Buttons, tenta disfarçar a morte do marido dizendo às câmaras de televisão que ele desapareceu. Só que ela começa a gostar da atenção que o caso lhe dá e vai tentar esticar o mais possível o seu novo estatuto de celebridade.

programme.title: True Justice: Alianças Criminosas
programme.desc: Elijah Kane conta com o apoio da sua equipa de especialistas para tentar deter os Yakuza, uma perigosa organização criminal, ao mesmo tempo que é forçado a lidar com um caso de reféns inocentes.

programme.title: True Justice: Operações Encobertas
programme.desc: O passado como militar nas operações especiais volta a assombrar o agente Elijah Kane, encarregue de investigar um violador em série e ainda um caso de contrabando de diamantes, comandado por um grupo de russos recém-chegados à cidade.

programme.title: Terra De Ninguém
programme.desc: Bill Greer e o seu filho Jackson estão de patrulha às suas terras na fronteira dos EUA quando este mata acidentalmente um jovem imigrante mexicano. Jackson foge a cavalo para o México, onde percorre desertos e montanhas em busca do perdão do pai do rapaz que matou, que jurou vingar-se dele.

programme.title: Dia da Redenção
programme.desc: Kate Paxton é raptada em Marrocos pelo líder de um grupo terrorista. Acabado de regressar a casa, Brad Paxton, capitão do exército americano, vê-se forçado a embarcar numa nova missão de resgate, desta vez para salvar a mulher que ama.

programme.title: Impacto Mortífero
programme.desc: Steve Wakes é um detetive da polícia determinado a encontrar o assassino que lhe matou o parceiro, num tiroteio que atingiu Madison, uma testemunha essencial no processo. Só que o seu grande receio confirma-se: os assassinos são dois polícias corruptos dispostos a tudo para encobrir o crime…

programme.title: Jogo Mortal
programme.desc: Marcus Jones é um agente da CIA enviado a Detroit para recolher informações que possam incriminar um negociante de armas e o responsável pelo fundo de investimento que o financia. Só que nem tudo corre pelo melhor, ele vai ser traído pelos colegas e terá de lutar pela própria vida.

programme.title: O Duelo
programme.desc: Em 1887, no Oeste americano, um Texas Ranger investiga uma série de mortes por explicar numa cidade chamada Helena.

programme.title: Conspiração Terrorista
programme.desc: Alice Racine é uma agente da CIA não conseguiu evitar um ataque terrorista que dizimou dezenas de vítimas e que é forçada a voltar à ação para tentar neutralizar um brutal ataque ao território britânico com uma arma biológica.

programme.title: Na Lista Do Assassino
programme.desc: O polícia “Dirty” Harry Callahan tem como missão travar um jogo secreto e doentio cujo objetivo é assassinar celebridades e em que um dos alvos é ele próprio.

programme.title: Um Homem Perigoso
programme.desc: Horas após sair da cadeia, onde esteve seis anos preso por um crime que não cometeu, Shane Daniels testemunha o assassinato de um polícia pela máfia chinesa, e vê-se na obrigação de ajudar uma menina e o seu tio cobrando favores antigos à máfia russa.

programme.title: Sacrifício
programme.desc: Um polícia atormentado torna-se amigo do padre local, em cuja igreja um traficante que quer mudar de vida esconde uma estátua cheia de drogas e cuja irmã de cinco anos vai ter de proteger.

programme.title: Os Segredos Que Ocultamos
programme.desc: Nos EUA, após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, uma refugiada romena reconstrói a vida com o marido americano mas ainda continua atormentada pela memória dos horrores do conflito, acabando por raptar um vizinho em busca de vingança pelos crimes de guerra hediondos que ela acredita que ele cometeu.

programme.title: Bizet - Carmen
programme.desc: The wild and breathtaking scenery of Austria's Roman Quarry of St. Margarethen provides an ideal and unique backdrop for this live and colourful open-air performance of Georges Bizet's opera Carmen (1875). With over 400 participants, this opulent staging of Bizet's famous opera - one of the most popular works in the genre's history - proves a feast for all the senses. Austria's Opera Festival St.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Rolando Villazón - One Night in Berlin
programme.desc: French-Mexican tenor Rolando Villazón (1972) is accompanied by the Südwestdeutsche Kammerphilharmonie Konstanz in performing a colourful recital from the Berliner Philharmonie. In this concert from 2006, Villazón performs various arias by Italian opera composers like Verdi, Rossini, Donizetti, Cilea and Mascagni. On the program are also some French works by Massenet, like Ô Souverain, ô juge, ô père from Le Cid and Toute mon âme est là!

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo And Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: Handel Celebration
programme.desc: The 250th anniversary of George Frederic Handel’s death takes place on April 14th, 2009. On this momentous occasion, two of the world’s leading baroque orchestras and conductor Howard Arman honour the composer by playing the repertoire of the historic Handel Commemoration Concert which took place in London’s Westminster Abbey 25 years after Handel’s death.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 4, Op. 18, No. 4
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: La Moresca - Addio, Daedalus
programme.desc: After more than thirty years at the top Ensemble Daedalus is saying goodbye to the concert stage. That demands a fitting farewell. Roberto Festa sought and found music that mirrors his journey over three decades.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: When it comes to shaping a musical event for the ears and the eyes, the monumental majesty of Anton Bruckner’s (1824-1896) symphonies and the exhilarating vibrancy of St. Florian’s monastery are a perfect match – especially when they are captured on film so thrillingly by such an eminent director as Brian Large in 2012.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Arisa Onoda
programme.desc: Pianist Arisa Onoda (Japan, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Mozart - Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622
programme.desc: Conductor Marien van Staalen leads Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622. Henk de Graaf is the featured soloist. This performance was recorded at St. Nicholas Church in Vollenhove, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Waldbühne Concert 1992: French Night
programme.desc: The Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Georges Prêtre (1924-2017), performs a French program during the Waldbühne Concert of 1992. The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20,000 seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 5, K 175
programme.desc: Malcolm Frager performs Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 5, K 175, a work of contrapuntal writing, a style that Mozart perfected under Padre Martini's tutelage. Discover the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera and conducted by Marc Andreae, at the Teatro Bibiena in Mantua.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Liszt and Ravel
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Delibes – Coppélia
programme.desc: A classic French ballet, Coppélia was choreographed in 1870 at the Opera de Paris, drawing inspiration from the evolution of society and the choreographer’s imagination. Featuring 40 dancers, the action takes place in the America of Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, and Jérôme Robbins and echoes the style and spirit of Broadway musicals and Hollywood fantasies.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano: Debussy, Gershwin a.o.
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital as part of the 2023 edition of the Amiata Piano Festival. On the program are Claude Debussy’s Cello Sonata, L. 135; Allegro moderato from Camille Saint-Saëns’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in C minor, Op. 32; Allegro ma non troppo from Johannes Brahms’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in E minor, Op.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture.

programme.title: Liszt - Piano Concerto No. 2, S.125
programme.desc: Alexander Ullman (1991, United Kingdom) performs Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 2 (S125) during the final of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht 2017. The competition actively presents, develops and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Rimsky-Korsakov - The Tale of Tsar Saltan Suite
programme.desc: In this exquisite 2016 concert from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, the Russian National Orchestra and star-pianist Boris Berezovsky are led by conductor Mikhail Pletnev in a performance of magnificent works by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 3,Op 30
programme.desc: The legendary pianist Vladimir Horowitz (1903-1989) won his first praise on his interpretation of Rachmaninoff's Third Piano Concerto from the composer himself. When Rachmaninoff heard the young Kiev-born pianist play his work shortly after Horowitz's arrival in New York in 1928, he exclaimed: 'He swallowed it whole.' Fifty years later, on September 24, 1978, Horowitz electrified his audience once again with this monumental work.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’.

programme.title: Playing Portraits
programme.desc: The trio composed of Alessandro Carbonare (clarinet), Elisa Eleonora Papandrea (violin) and Monaldo Braconi (piano) performs regularly in Italy’s concert halls and abroad. Playing Portraits showcases the trio’s appearances in various places, including USA, Russia and Europe, as they perform works by composers such as George Gershwin, Igor Stravinsky, Francis Poulenc, Anton Guilio Priolo, and Reiner Kuttenberger.

programme.title: Rodrigo - Concierto de Aranjuez
programme.desc: Juan Manuel Cañizares is the soloist in a performance of Joaquín Rodrigo's (1901-1999) Concierto de Aranjuez. He is accompanied by the Berliner Philharmoniker led by maestro Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Hector Berlioz’ ‘Symphonie Fantastique’.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.desc: Neste programa documental de uma hora, acompanhamos um dia completo na vida de uma pessoa, que pode ser uma celebridade, um artista, um artesão ou alguém anónimo, como um taxista. A cada banca, uma história.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 7

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 10

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 12

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 13

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T8 - Ep. 10

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 50
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 84
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. programme.title: Tamara Murphy - Spirograph Studies
programme.desc: Spirograph Studies have leapt onto the Australian music scene with their detailed, textural approach to playing improvised music. Post-rock, post-jazz and post-minimalism, they shamelessly steal sonic palettes from all areas to build their cinematic sound. This collaborative group features Luke Howard (piano), Fran Swinn (guitar) and James McLean (drums).

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Jazz in Comblain-la-Tour, 1963
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith’s All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues.

programme.title: Stan Getz Quintet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Legendary American saxophonist Stan Getz gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague in 1980.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Ray Charles live at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Forest GIIPUJA
programme.desc: GIIPUJA has been bringing modern jazz with a distinct ethnic flavor to Croatian audiences since 2013. The unusual line-up of double bass, drums, bass clarinet, violin, and various folkloristic instruments from the Istria region, makes for a strikingly original and unique sound.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sonny Sharrock - Peanut
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Sven Figee
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Sluijs And Vermeulen
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs and pianist Erik Vermeulen both had a classical training.

programme.title: Whatever
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Wouter Hamel Live in Paradiso
programme.desc: What Jamie Cullum is to England, Wouter Hamel is to the Netherlands: a performer who knows the difference between jazz and pop! Hamel is backed by big band Sven Happel (double bass), Jasper van Hulten (drums), Gijs Anders van Straalen (percussion), Rory Ronde (guitar), Benjamin Herman (saxophone), and a string ensemble. Hamel plays the guitar, piano, sings, and writes many of his own songs.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist?Henry Hey?(David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff 'Tain' Watts) and bassist?Michael League?(Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist?Chris McQueen?and drummer?Jason 'JT' Thomas.

programme.title: Tribute to Elis Regina - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: Children of the Night
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: I Own the Night
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: You Don't Know What Love Is
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Oh Purity in Watching Landscapes
programme.desc: This documentary shows a song cycle by the Danish singer-songwriter Trinelise Væring and pianist Jonas Berg, featuring the Scandinavian Barokksolistene ensemble headed by solo violinist and artistic director Bjarte Eike.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: Al Jarreau - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Apasionado
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Elliot Galvin Trio - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Trio Florizoone - Massot
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the trio Massot/Florizoone/Horbaczewski.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: November Music 2017: Daniel Herskedal
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands. Norwegian tuba player and composer Daniel Herskedal trained at the Trondheim and Copenhagen Music Conservatories.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: TorTube: Eric Vloeimans And Florian Weber
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features 'GGG' Gennady Golovkin (23-1, 20 KOs) making his American debut defending his WBA and IBO middleweight world titles against Grzegorz 'Super G' Proska (28-1, 21 KOs).

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Floyd Mayweather, Jr., in the final bout before his first retirement from boxing, facing Ricky Hatton in a superfight. Mayweather has referred to Hatton as one of the toughest competitors he has ever had to face. Also on the card, a young Saul (Canelo) Alvarez continues to rise in the rankings.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T30 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Meisei, Tsurugisho, Kotonowaka and Tobizaru.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: This episode features a lightweight title bout between Juan Manuel Marquez and Juan Diaz, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This episode follows former UFC welterweight champion Matt Serra around his hometown in New Jersey for a look at the lighter side of this intense competitor. Ring girl Natasha Wicks shows us that the fighters aren't the only ones with the big guns. Plus a behind the scenes look at the UFC Fan Expo and an interview with MMA legend Chael Sonnen.

programme.title: FS MMA T2 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: This episode of FIGHT SPORTS MMA features action from KSW 100 with the main event which saw veteran middleweight star, Mamed Khalidov take on unbeaten Adrian Bartosinski.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the Hohhot Grand Prix, and stop to get to know the world's #1 ranked fighter Aleksandar Kukolj. We then head to Russia to witness the effect that Judo has on the Russian people.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a battle among heavyweights as Travis Walker faces the then-undefeated Chris Arreola, who was ranked in the top 10 by four of the boxing organizations. While the fight seems to go to one side after the opening bell, the momentum quickly shifts.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T30 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 4, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan features Shodai, Asanoyama, Hokutofuji and Takanosho.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T11 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Women's Forms as well as Boy's Weapons and Men's Traditional Forms.

programme.title: Prison Fighters T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.desc: Como é que o Egito ascendeu ao seu derradeiro período de esplendor sob o poder da dinastia Ptolomeia? E como é que o Império acabou por ruir sob a sua governação?.

programme.title: As Maiores Descobertas Com Dan Snow T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Dan Snow reconstitui a história de Stonehenge, analisando os mitos antigos e as mais recentes descobertas.

programme.title: As Maiores Descobertas Com Dan Snow T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Dan Snow explora a incrível história do Exército de Terracota chinês – da sua descoberta fortuita nos anos 70 às últimas descobertas.

programme.title: Alienígenas T11 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Muitas culturas ancestrais por todo o mundo acreditavam que os meteoritos não eram simples pedregulhos caídos do céu, mas pedras sagradas imbuídas do poder dos deuses.

programme.title: Alienígenas T14 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em 2021, o Governo dos EUA quebrou um precedente de negação dos OVNIS já com 70 anos e divulgou um relatório revolucionário sobre os Fenómenos Aéreos Não Identificados.

programme.title: Alienígenas T11 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Chariots of the Gods', de Erich von Dniken, desafiou tudo o que julgávamos saber sobre a História da Humanidade, sugerindo que a Terra foi visitada por alienígenas num passado distante.

programme.title: A Máscara De Ferro: O Enigma Do Rei Sol T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Eustache Dauger, encarcerado durante 34 anos, continua a ser o prisioneiro mais misterioso de França. Este episódio explora a hipótese de um laço de sangue real.

programme.title: Contra Todas as Regras
programme.desc: Depois de uma ilustre carreira nas operações especiais terminar em desastre, Alexander retira-se e leva uma vida tranquila. Mas quando a sua família fica na mira de um gangster russo, Alexander é arrastado para uma guerra entre gangues rivais.

programme.title: Five Nights at Freddy´s
programme.desc: Um segurança problemático começa a trabalhar na Freddy Fazbear´s Pizza. Durante suas cinco noites de trabalho, ele percebe que algo está errado com a pizzaria e logo descobre a verdade sobre seus animatrônicos.

programme.title: Sede de Viver
programme.desc: Um menino cai sob a tutela não convencional do seu tio, um barman carismático e autodidata.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Medieval
programme.desc: A história do ícone tcheco do século XV e senhor da guerra, Jan Zizka, que derrotou os exércitos da Ordem Teutônica e do Sacro Império Romano.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Uma vaga de protestos ocorre em Detroit, no ano de 1967, quando uma operação policial não autorizada provoca a revolta entre a população. Os agentes da autoridade intervêm, mas a justiça da sua forma de atuar é questionável. Baseada em factos reais.

programme.title: Lamborghini - O Homem Por Detrás da Lenda
programme.desc: Este filme biográfico emocionante e de alta velocidade revela o sonho de um homem de fabricar o carro mais rápido do mundo - e vencer o rival Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: In The Heart Of The Sea
programme.desc: No inverno de 1820, Essex, um navio baleeiro de Nova Inglaterra, foi atacado por uma baleia gigante com um sentido de vingança praticamente humano, deixando a tripulação à deriva. Um desastre marítimo que inspirou a mítica obra ´Moby Dick´.

programme.title: 10.000 A.C.
programme.desc: D´Leh, caçador de mamutes, sobrevive a um quotidiano agreste e gélido quando descobre que o Mundo em que vive é bem mais amplo e inesperado do que imaginava.

programme.title: Van Damme - Duplo Impacto
programme.desc: Chad e Alex são irmãos gémeos separados depois da morte dos pais. Um cresceu em Paris, o outro em Hong Kong. Ao ver uma fotografia do irmão, Chad vai para Hong Kong, mas as suas intenções podem não ser as melhores.

programme.title: Kong: Ilha Da Caveira
programme.desc: Uma recriação da origem do mítico Kong, onde uma equipa de cientistas explora uma ilha desconhecida do Pacífico - com tanto de encantadora como de traiçoeira - alheios ao facto de estarem a entrar no território do gorila gigante...

programme.title: Godzilla: Rei Dos Monstros
programme.desc: Um grupo de cientistas enfrenta uma série de monstros gigantescos que se julgava serem mitos e onde se inclui o poderoso Godzilla que enfrenta Mothra, Rodan e o seu derradeiro inimigo, o Rei de Três Cabeças Ghidorah. Todos eles lutam pela supremacia.

programme.title: O Fiel Jardineiro
programme.desc: Um diplomata britânico colocado no Quénia procura descobrir a razão do homicídio da sua mulher.

programme.title: O Guarda-Costas e o Assassino
programme.desc: O maior assassino profissional do mundo sai da sombra para testemunhar contra o seu antigo patrão. Para se defender contrata o mais famoso guarda-costas e juntos terão de pôr de lado as diferenças para conseguirem chegar a tempo ao julgamento.

programme.title: Ataque ao Terror
programme.desc: Um grupo de impiedosos terroristas rapta a filha do primeiro-ministro e barrica-se num parque de estacionamento subterrâneo cheio de explosivos. Uma equipa de especialistas é enviada para fazer o resgate, mas terão de ocupar o edifício piso a piso…

programme.title: Lendas do Crime
programme.desc: A história da ascensão e queda dos mais famosos gangsters de Londres, os gémeos Reggie e Ronnie Kray. Juntos tomam conta da cidade, mas a ligação de ambos enfraquece quando as divergências surgem, causadas por lutas pelo poder, loucura e por uma mulher...

programme.title: O Código do Silêncio
programme.desc: Um polícia de Chicago é apanhado no meio de uma guerra de gangs, enquanto os seus próprios camaradas o evitam porque ele quer acabar com um polícia irresponsável.

programme.title: Uma Boa Pessoa
programme.desc: Segue Allison, cuja vida se desmorona após o seu envolvimento num acidente fatal.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Um jovem e uma jovem crescem, correm e se apaixonam no Vale de San Fernando, 1973.

programme.title: O Jogo Final
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, o jovem Ender Wiggin é recrutado para liderar a luta contra os Formics, uma raça alienígena hostil, que quase acabou com a vida humana durante a sua primeira invasão ao planeta Terra.

programme.title: Red - Perigosos
programme.desc: Frank Moses é um agente secreto reformado que vê a sua pacata vida ser interrompida por um assassino profissional que o tenta matar. Ele decide reunir a velha equipa e descobre que a própria CIA os quer eliminar.

programme.title: xXx: O Regresso de Xander Cage
programme.desc: De regresso do seu exílio voluntário, Xander Cage encontra-se agora em rota de colisão com o guerreiro Xiang, numa corrida para recuperar uma arma sinistra e aparentemente imparável, conhecida por Caixa de Pandora.

programme.title: O Cavaleiro das Trevas Renasce
programme.desc: Passaram-se oito anos desde que Batman desapareceu na noite tornando-se, nesse momento, de herói a fugitivo. Mas o aparecimento de um novo terrorista em Gotham City vai fazer Bruce Wayne sair do seu exílio auto-imposto.

programme.title: Blue Beetle
programme.desc: Um escaravelho alienígena escolhe Jaime Reyes para ser seu hospedeiro simbiótico, concedendo ao recém-formado uma armadura capaz de poderes extraordinários, mudando para sempre seu destino ao se tornar o super-herói conhecido como Besouro Azul.

programme.title: O Assassino Perfeito
programme.desc: Um agente da lei tem de sacrificar tudo para salvar uma jovem rapariga de quem se tornou amigo da sua chefe femme fatale, que está envolvida no tráfico de sexo cibernético.

programme.title: Destroyer: Ajuste de Contas
programme.desc: A odisseia moral e existencialista da detetive da polícia de Los Angeles Erin Bell que, enquanto jovem polícia, foi infiltrada num gang no deserto da Califórnia, um caso que resultou em trágicas consequências.

programme.title: American Pie: O Reencontro
programme.desc: Todas as personagens de ´American Pie´ regressam a East Great Falls para uma reunião de colegas do liceu. Num longo fim-de-semana descobrem o que mudou, o que não mudou e que o tempo e a distância não quebra os laços da amizade.

programme.title: Diamante de Sangue
programme.desc: Durante a guerra civil na Serra Leoa, um homem negro e um mercenário branco formam equipa para recuperarem um valioso diamante cobiçado por um traficante.

programme.title: Zone Interdite
programme.desc: On rêve tous de vacances au soleil à petit prix. Pour cela, de plus en plus de Français se tournent vers les nouvelles destinations stars de la Méditerranée. Trois destinations qui promettent soleil, plages de rêve et bons plans. Mais que valent-elles...

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Voisins : vont-ils se mettre d'accord ? Il y a 15 ans, Gaëlle est venue s’installer dans le Cantal : un petit village de 10 maisons et 70 habitants où elle pensait vivre tranquille. Chez Isabelle aussi, l’ambiance est explosive. Elle est à la tête d’une véritable...

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest se rend à Chambéry en Savoie dans le restaurant de Christine. C’est Paula, la commerçante d’en face, qui a fait appel à lui. Depuis 3 ans, Christine a repris le plus vieux restaurant de la ville, une véritable institution, mais depuis quelques mois, les clients désertent l’établissement et Paula est très inquiète pour son amie. Le chef va rapidement découvrir que la situation est préoccupante et que rien ne va...

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Le chef Philippe Etchebest va intervenir dans le restaurant de Mimose et Georget, à Saint-Gervais dans le Gard. Ce couple de Réunionnais a repris cet établissement il y a 4 ans et Georget est loin d’être novice puisqu’il a travaillé pour la Maison Troisgros (3 étoiles) et que son mentor n’est autre que Serge Chenet, un Meilleur Ouvrier de France ! Un CV exceptionnel jamais vu dans Cauchemar en cuisine ! Alors pourquoi Mimose...

Esta saborosa questão inspirou a criação do programa apresentado pela jornalista e chef de cozinha Larissa Januário. Em cada dia da semana, larissa vai ajudar os espectadores a fazer melhor escolha para o seu jantar.
